ciel: Regenerated the 32-frame Cycles volume atlas with axial thermal cooling and directional scattering.
Retarded emission separates nozzle shutdown from the travel and cooling of already emitted flame.
Finite sparks cool to ash instead of restarting after extinction; reflected light and smoke have a one-shot lifecycle.
rexonance: Both entry and scroll flames have rising thermal crests, a stretched extinction plume, and branches that inherit parent breakup.
Incoming nanites flatten their capture helix before axial insertion.
Induction rails follow actual moving anchors into fixed sockets; moving weld fronts cool from white to gold to copper.
p14: Two-core calibration rail replaces the plain comparator presentation, with a seated luminous thumb and active endpoint.
Preserves binary P1/P2 values, exact comparison data, native iOS select, vertical touch scrolling and keyboard operation.
Forced colors use system paints; economy and reduced motion disable decorative transitions.

preserved: Central reactor is fixed; surrounding coil formation and rotation are unchanged.
Supplied artwork, authored face pixels, cover timing and final armour positions are unchanged.
Ciel requires ten deliberate taps, exposes no stop button, and retains the burned page until real reload.
Existing canvas pixel, sprite and adaptive quality limits remain bounded; no startup 3D dependency was added.

blender.method: Procedural closed volume meshes; not a fluid dynamics simulation

ciel.chromium: 320px, 1024px landscape, desktop; normal, extended recovery/input/retention checks
ciel.webkit: 320px; normal, reduced motion, no WebGL, blocked jet asset

rexonance.webkit: 320px normal/blocked, including entry, forward/reverse scroll, finish, hidden stop and natural return
rexonance.loadingRecovery: WebKit resize-notice, decode-exception, network-recovery: all passed
rexonance.sampledAllocation: Existing regression passed: rich extras 17.06 MiB versus classic 33.91 MiB; not a speedup or zero-allocation claim
rexonance.verifierCorrection: Blocked mode now requires real procedural fallback and zero atlas draws in the same native frame window as nanites. Normal mode still requires actual atlas draws.

p14.checks: 320px/1024px, endpoint and track clicks, Home/End, vertical touch, native iPad-UA select, forced colors, reduced motion, economy, final comparison values

limitations: Browser emulation is not physical iPhone or iPad verification; the native OS picker requires a physical device.

The optional natural-clock Rexonance screenshot run missed a narrow target because screenshot capture was late; its failure evidence is retained. Native painter observation and exact canonical boundary checks passed.
No claim of a fixed performance improvement or real-time ray tracing.
Publication is verified separately against the exact commit and public asset hashes.
